subject: Log unused module configuration entries that cause redis to abort (#132)
reason: The change only adds serverLog lines enumerating unused module config names immediately before a pre-existing exit(1) at startup; the abort behavior, exit path, and all runtime behavior are unchanged. The path fires only when a config file names a module config without its loadmodule directive, which makes the server die at startup — a configuration the harness skips as unsupported — and no fuzzer oracle observes startup log text of an intentionally aborting process.
